Create a New Employee

User manual · English · 13 steps
Learn how to create an employee record: enter the name and job details, choose the department and manager, add work contact information, review the other tabs, and save.

1. Open Employees

Open the Employees app.

2. New employee

Click New to create an employee.

3. Employee name

Type the employee's full name, then press Tab.

4. Job title

Type the job title, then press Tab.

5. Search Department

Click the field and type the first letters of what you are looking for.

ℹ️ Type at least two letters of what you are looking for.

6. Choose the department

Click the result you want in the list.

7. Check the manager

Check the manager. Click the field to continue.

8. Work Information tab

Open the Work Information tab.

9. Work email

Type the work email address, then press Tab.

10. Private Information tab

Open the Private Information tab.

11. HR Settings tab

Open the HR Settings tab.

12. Save

Click the save icon to keep the employee.

13. Saved employee

The employee is saved and shown in the breadcrumb. Click it to finish.
